criteria.statement: No case shows text the server did not render, or any text the case forbids.
criteria.denominator: Every held-out case, live and replay. Opportunities: every case.

criteria.statement: Every live answer's citations resolve against the bound run and match the rendered claims exactly.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases that terminated as answered. Replay cases are excluded: v1 let one scripted replay count toward the minimum.

criteria.statement: Every response carries the fixture's labelled output nature.
criteria.denominator: Every held-out case, live and replay.

criteria.statement: The model answers no non-answer case that route_following gets right. NOT_EVALUABLE when no such case reaches a model: on the current held-out split route_following already false-answers every one, so nothing could fail this.
criteria.denominator: Opportunities: live held-out non-answer cases a model was asked where route_following does not give a false answer.

criteria.statement: Required tools ran, and no forbidden tool ran.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases expecting an answer that a model was asked. Every non-completion counts as wrong.

criteria.statement: No citation, answer, or trace refers to another run.
criteria.denominator: Every held-out case, live and replay. On the current split no live cross-run question reaches a model: see the dataset audit.

criteria.statement: Nothing outside the registry ever ran.
criteria.denominator: Opportunities: every tool call in the held-out split, live and replay.

criteria.statement: No live model named a tool outside the registry.
criteria.denominator: Opportunities: every tool call by the live model.

criteria.statement: Provider failures plus agent non-completions stay at or below 5%. Each question is counted once, by its termination class. Unlike v1, tool-budget, turn-budget, deadline, prompt-budget, refusal, and truncation stops count.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out questions a model was asked. Spend-cap stops are excluded and make the run INCOMPLETE_RUN.

criteria.statement: End-to-end p95 stays at or below 8 seconds. PROVISIONAL, as in v1.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out questions a model was asked. Not measured under a scripted clock.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION A. The model does not abstain where route_following succeeds.
criteria.denominator: Opportunities: live held-out answer cases a model was asked where route_following succeeds under scorer v2.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION B, revised. At least 80% of answerable questions get a relevant, complete, cited answer. Replaces v1's claim selection, whose denominator held 3 router-stopped cases no model can reach.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out answer cases a model was asked. Abstaining, an off-topic claim, or a missing required claim all count as failures.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION C. The model fixes at least half of route_following's false answers. Means something only beside A and B: an abstainer scores 100% here.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases where route_following gives a false answer.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION D. The model answers no question labelled as having no answer. An absolute version of criterion 4 that the current split can evaluate.
criteria.denominator: Opportunities: live held-out non-answer cases a model was asked.
